quote_text: We have won! We won! We won! Finally, after 13 years, we are the World Champions. Somebody pinch me! Is this a dream?! We actually won the World Cup! It's crazy! What a match! It was an extremely nail-biting match. The match was almost lost. TVs were almost destroyed. Depression was almost upon us. But ultimately, our mental health was safe. God's plan, baby! God's plan! The most epic comeback by Team India. The penance of 140cr Indians bore fruit. I'm still standing there... But now I'm bursting crackers! Because we won! It's time to delete all the sad edits and memes. It's time to make reels on 'Lehra Do' and 'Teeja Tera Rang Tha Mai To'. Update your playlist, we'll play these songs for a while. Tears were shed on the 19th, and tears were shed today, on the 29th. But they are diagonally opposite. Watching our team lift the trophy is a source of immense happiness. Watching Virat and Rohit with the tricolor. These photos and videos are so soothing. We were dying to see these players happy. I'm so happy for them today! And yes, you're amazing, Big Brother. Before IPL began, he said... 'India will be victorious on 29th June, in Barbados under Rohit's captaincy.' And we did exactly that! This scripting is unreal! How is this humanly possible?! We made fun of you, Big Brother, but you are actually the scriptwriter. Yes, I know, it was a joyous moment. We were about to celebrate, but... Virat and Rohit both announced retirement from T20s. At least give us one day to celebrate happily! Why did they say it right after the match? Anyway, we'll talk about it later. For now, let's enjoy the victory. Don't complain if there are less jokes in this video. I'm not used to making videos in such a happy mood. We haven't won a World Cup for so long... The best thing about time is, it changes. Man, the sad photo, and then this photo with the tricolor and the trophy... This is what we needed! Don't say that this victory can't compensate for the defeat on 19th November. I believe that this is a big win and we must savor it. Let's not be stuck up on the past. World Cup final: We're back! It's so over! We're back! It's over! This is so true! There were ups and downs! Both the teams choked! This match was up in the air! But we won! And actually, it was the perfect World Cup final! It was so thrilling! This was seriously a match between two chokers. First, India choked, then South Africa choked. Then India choked, then South Africa choked! India choked again, but in the end, thankfully South Africa choked again. At one point, South Africa needed 30 runs in 30 balls. Two set batsmen on the crease. How could they lose?! Also, how did we win?! We played really well! There was a 96.62% probability that South Africa would win this match! India only had a 3.38% chance of winning. Then in the last 5 overs, Bumrah, Arshdeep and Hardik Pandya flipped the script! We have to talk about Hardik Pandya first. He took Klassen's wicket and David Miller's wicket. These two set batsmen were giving us a hard time. This is redemption. Clutch God Pandya, Kung Fu Pandya, bow down to him! The crowd that booed him, trolled him and cussed him one month ago... are singing his praises today! Clutch God Pandya, please forgive me if I trolled you. I didn't troll him much, but I still want to apologize. Sorry for thinking that you wouldn't play well for India. I don't care how he plays for Mumbai. He is on another level when he plays for India. They needed 16 runs to win in the last over. And Hardik Pandya was the bowler. What a poetic end to the whole Hardik Pandya saga. I'm sure no one will troll him now. No one will doubt him. Don't forget that he was our vice-captain for this World Cup. He was called a selfish loafer. People from his franchise began hating him. Mumbai fans never accepted him. Gujarat fans were hating him. All Indian fans were hating him. It looked like he faced problems in his personal life. And yet, against all odds, this man came through. Hats off! And it's not like he only performed once. He played well throughout the WC. His tears wouldn't stop after winning. He knows this is a big victory for him. He said, 'I faced grave injustice but I didn't utter a word.' His game answered the critics on the biggest stage. I genuinely respect Hardik from the bottom of my heart. I almost cried when I saw him crying. Then I saw the video where Rohit kissed Hardik. That made me more emotional. I wanted Rohit to kiss him from my side as well. I already posted a reel on 'Lehra Do'. Follow me on Instagram and watch it. The truth is, love him or hate him, we only have one Hardik Pandya. And he is irreplaceable. He proved it! Your apology needs to be as loud as your disrespect was. Everyone should span 'Sorry Hardik' in the comments. Mumbai fans should be first in line! Why stop at 'Sorry Hardik'? Let's also write 'Sorry Surya'. Forget about fielding medal, you can have my property papers! You can have my car keys, take my YouTube password. What an amazing catch! He caught the World Cup! I was preparing the memes when I saw Surya's batting. But the truth is, Surya's unreal catch won us the game. The ball almost crossed the boundary. I don't know how he managed to catch the ball after jumping to keep it in. I can't! I can't explain it! Look at the reaction from my livestream. O great Gods... Answer my prayers... May Hardik Pandya take Miller's wicket! On this ball. In the air! Is he out? No. Oh my God! Oh my God! Oh Surya! Oh Surya! What a catch! Let's go! Surya! All the sins can be forgiven after that catch. That reminds me, since we're apologizing to Surya and Hardik... Let's also apologize to Mr Kingam Dube. Everyone wanted Rinku Singh to play. I think he wouldn't have done more than what Shivam Dube did in the final. Dube had been contributing throughout the World Cup. But only for memes. Today he actually contributed to the match and helped us win. Today, Dube the King finally played the way we always wanted him to. I told you, he'd find his form before the World Cup ends. The thing is, everyone expected Virat Kohli to play well in this match. And he delivered. But no one expected anything out of Dube. He himself didn't expect anything out of himself. Please forgive me, I made a mistake. 27 needed from 28 balls. You can't win from here. Hardikprit Singh: Hold my ball, son. Hardik, Bumrah and Arshdeep, they made history. Bumrah's performance can't be expressed in words. He's a national treasure for us. Listen, hide him somewhere, protect him. Let's make him play only in the World Cup. Thank you Bumrah, you take a nice wicket and help me promote my Telegram. Reeza Hendricks' wicket was the ball of the century. I uploaded it on Telegram, go and watch it. He took Hendrick's wicket and changed the game. In his final two overs, he only conceded 6 runs. He made killer Miller ineffective. Bumrah has done this throughout the tournament, not just this match. We knew that we could only progress as much as King Bumrah wanted us to. In 8 matches, he took 15 wickets with an economy of 4.2. Also, he conceded less boundaries than the number of wickets he took. Only 12 boundaries conceded. Watch these stats closely, you don't get to see them often. As a result, he is also the player of the tournament. Well deserved. Sanjana, go to your mom's place for a month. Step aside, Sanjana! We are here! Step aside Sanjana. Look at the line. I'm with them. I too queued up. Bumrah worked hard and got enough credit. But one person didn't get enough credit. That's Arshdeep Singh. He is the joint-highest wicket-taker of this tournament with 17 wickets. In this match, he took Markram and De Kock's wicket. I was so happy when he conquered the 19th over. We always trolled him for the 19th over. But today, he conceded only 4 runs in the 19th over. He wasn't the man of the tournament but he certainly won everyone's hearts. Kuldeep's bowling wasn't effective in this match. But overall in this tournament he has been very good for us. But Axar, your batting is also good along with your bowling. This modern-day Bapu loves violence. Forget about Sanjana and Anushka. First, tell me who decided to move Axar up the batting order? I want to- it was an unfortunate run-out. Had he stayed on, he could've scored more runs. But still, he contributed 47 runs in the final. Even after being moved up the batting order. This is nothing new, India was in trouble, Axar had to step up. He did have a score to settle with South Africa. Gandhi almost left our notes after Axar's batting. But he stayed on because of his bowling. Oh well, it happens. It wasn't Axar's fault. The pitch was to blame. Nothing could've been done. Someone had to bowl one over. But I was scared! He conceded so many runs in that over. Jadeja didn't contribute much. He couldn't bat well. And he didn't offer much with his bowling. It's okay, it happens. I have a few words for Rishab Pant, but I'll stop myself today. It'd be controversial. He was a good wicketkeeper and had some good catches. We can't forget about Siraj. He performed well earlier in the tournament. We had to bench him and get Kuldeep to balance the team. But he would've performed well had he played today. Siraj is a cutie. His English is so cute and he is so emotional. I mean... Rinku, Sanju, Jaiswal and Khaleel win the World Cup trophy. Wow, winner winner chicken dinner with zero kills. Come on, man... They were there for moral support. Sanju, Jaiswal, Rinku and Chahal didn't get to play, but they won. God's plan. For South Africa, it was their first final, it meant a lot to them also. They played well all things considered. It's fine, it was your first final. We have played many and lost many. Oh well, it happens. Hopefully we meet again in a final. Considering South Africa's history, everyone knew that they'd choke. But when? They needed 30 runs to win off 30 balls, then 26 to win off 24 balls. When will they choke?! But eventually, they did. Still, they lost only by 7 runs. They gave a heart attack to 150Cr Indians. Klassen, Stubbs, De Kock, Rabada, Miller, everyone played well. I hope they get other opportunities in the future. If they keep playing well, they might win. It's South Africa, we wouldn't mind if they play well and win in the future. I would've dissed if it was Australia. Rohit GOAT, Kohli GOAT, Pandya GOAT, Axar GOAT. Dube little GOAT, Surya big GOAT. Dravid greatest, everyone GOAT. Bumrah eclipses them all. Everyone is a GOAT. Everyone is a GOAT! All our players are GOATs! Love everybody! We won the cup by 7 runs. The target was 177 runs and we lost 7 wickets. No Dhoni, don't steal the credit. The credit goes to our 15 players. But yes, Thala for a reason. Dhoni finally remembered his Instagram. He has posted for the boys. Wow sir! Amazing! Now, two minutes of silence for those... who thought Kohli wouldn't perform in the final because he flopped otherwise. Did you forget that he is the man who steps up on big occasions. He was the POTM. 76 runs, but... in his last T20 match. In the first seven matches, he scored 75 runs. And he scored 76 runs in the final. But I'd say a fitting end to his T20 career. 2014, 2016, 2022... he gave it his all in every World Cup. The tournament wasn't going well. You could tell by looking at his face after the first inning that he wasn't happy. Because it was slow. But I don't think anyone else could've played the anchor's role as Virat did. That's the only reason why we reached a respectable total. Also, those who call him Chokli, selfish, and stat-padder, are you done? Bow down at his feet. Because he won the cup! His selfish inning won us the cup. He broke the records yet again. Thank you so much for all the contributions, Virat. He wasn't at his best in this Cup. But my heart knew that he'd do something. And he did. He met our expectations. Kohli is the only cricketer to win U-19 WC, ODI WC, T20i WC and Champions Trophy. The GOAT has actually completed cricket. Well, that's true. I feel good, I mean... This T20 WC is a big deal for Virat. Yep, this is the photo. We got Virat Kohli kissing the World Cup trophy before GTA 6. I hope Kohli and Rohit post a picture of them sleeping with the trophy like Messi. I can do that too. I don't know how excited I'd be for the next T20 bilateral series. Because Virat and Rohit wouldn't be a part of the T20 setup. I am genuinely pleased for Rohit Sharma. He is the player who always said, 'All I see is the trophy, I want it.' He finally got it. He laid down on the ground, his emotions were pouring out. People trolled him during IPL. People questioned if he would even fit in the T20 setup. And they're taking him only for captaincy. But still, he proved everybody wrong. Sure, he didn't bat too well in this match. But the intent was the same. His efforts have been consistent throughout. His contributions helped in the victory against Australia and England. The only captain after Dhoni to win an ICC trophy for us. People thought what could a captain with 5 IPL trophies do for the nation? Well, the trophy is in his hands. He ended our wait of 13 years. It's obviously sad to see that Virat and Rohit won't play anymore T20s, but... All good things come to an end. ESPN posted this with the caption 'Iconic'. Rohit Sharma is lying down, he looks relieved now. I'll soon make a video on Rohit and Virat's performances and T20 careers. So subscribe to the channel. Also, we can't forget coach Rahul Dravid. Under him, we were in the Semi-Final of the 2022 T20 WC. As well as the WTC final. We won the Asia Cup. And we were unbeaten till the final in the 2023 World Cup. Plus, we won the ICC T20 World Cup 2024 while remaining unbeaten. I think Rahul Dravid's tenure as a coach was very good. And the end was fitting. Seeing him get emotional while celebrating felt good. This is for you bro. This is Prafull Billore. Come on, man! His contribution can't be denied. He didn't spare South Africa. He took a selfie with every player in the team. He even made their passport. He did everything he could to curse them. And it worked. Thank you, Praful. You'll be useful in the next ICC tournament. In the end, thank you Team India. Thank you so much for making us happy. This win will keep my mental health good for the next couple of years. Until the next ICC event. Truly, we are all proud of our boys. And, I'll take my leave. Thank you so much for watching. Love you all. Bye-Bye. Watch this video.
